sources.title: Inverse design of functional materials: a case study in thermoelectrics
limitations: comparator/method context, not local ground truth

admission_rules: source metadata alone cannot mint a thermoelectric benchmark observation
every component observation must bind exact material/phase/dopant/carrier/temperature/direction state
Seebeck, sigma, sigma_over_tau, kappa_e, kappa_l, power factor and zT remain separately custodied propositions
same parent compound across temperature/carrier/doping trajectories is leakage-related rather than independent unseen material
experimentally validated descendants of a training parent require explicit family/ancestry edges
published inverse-design outcomes are exposure evidence and cannot enter a future prospective hidden-answer set
source or license gaps remain explicit Unknown/Unavailable states rather than silently filled from secondary summaries
